summary: Iteration 3 testing for Billy's Store RBAC + stock decrement + email silent-skip. Backend: 40/40 pytest cases passing (15 new iteration-3 tests + 25 iteration-2 regression). Frontend: /admin/users flow validated end-to-end (super_admin sees 5 sidebar items + 'SUPER ADMIN' role badge, create products_editor works, own row hides role select + delete, other users show role selector + delete, delete flow confirmed).
critical_code_review_comments: admin.py POST /admin/products uses `Depends(get_current_admin)` while PUT/DELETE use `require_perm('products')`. This means any authenticated admin (including orders_manager) can CREATE a product but not update/delete. Recommend switching POST /admin/products to `require_perm('products')` for consistency with RBAC spec.

server.py create_order: when payment_method='flutterwave' and FLW_SECRET_KEY is empty, HTTPException(503) is raised AFTER stock decrement. The outer try/except restores stock — verified path works. However, the promo_code uses counter is bumped BEFORE flutterwave initialization for non-Flutterwave method only, so no risk. Good.

admin.py decrement_stock rollback is not atomic across items (multiple update_one calls without a mongo transaction). Under sustained concurrency this can leak stock temporarily; acceptable for MVP. Consider bulk_write or transactions for a production-grade fix.

admin.py send_order_confirmation_email swallows all exceptions silently — good behaviour for missing key, but a Resend API 4xx error would also be hidden. Consider logging at WARN level when RESEND_API_KEY is set but call fails.
AdminUsers.jsx: password field type='text' (visible while typing). For usability of an invite flow acceptable, but should be type='password' by default with a toggle.
